hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that uses Euler vault positions as its liquidity layer. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts via a bonding curve, deposits input tokens to an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifies the curve invariant — fully replacing the standard Uniswap v4 CLAMM. Reverts on direct liquidity additions and donations to prevent unproductive positions.
